panel.title: Orchestration
panel.description: The controller only assigns work, reads reports, and accepts results. Writing code, merging, running tests, and pushing all happen on your computers and the local AI.
panel.generating: The controller is building a plan…
panel.manageHint: Manage projects in Settings → Projects, and computers in Settings → Controller & computers
panel.noLocation: (No verified project location yet. Add one in Settings → Projects.)
panel.crossHint: When selected, subtasks are also sent to these machines. The integration branch and subtask branches are pushed to origin as a relay (never force-pushed). Merging and checks still happen at the project location chosen above.
panel.allowShell: Allow the local AI to run test commands
panel.grantHint: Development and merge need the local AI to commit, so workspace write and git write are always granted. Integration branch: {{branch}}. Uncommitted changes in the main repository are not copied into the worktree. After you confirm, this round does not ask again step by step.
panel.rejectRequired: A rejection must include a reason

worktrees.title: Worktree management
worktrees.intro: This lists the worktrees each computer created for orchestration. That computer lists and deletes them on its own machine; the server only sees what it reports. A confirmation card appears before anything is deleted. Worktrees with uncommitted changes, or ones an orchestration is still using, are not deleted.
